sm_top.sm: IRGC navy reports an oil tanker hit a mine in the Strait of Hormuz.
Syria and Jordan reopened a border crossing following earlier Jordanian airstrikes in Syria.
The Houthis claimed responsibility for a missile strike targeting a Saudi oil refinery.
Riyadh airport partially reopened following previous attacks and drone interceptions.
The Saudi-led coalition says it destroyed three drones over Riyadh and southern Saudi Arabia.
Ballistic missile and airstrike attacks in Aden triggered loud explosions and caused casualties, including reported deaths.
A drone strike on a market in Nyala killed numerous people.
Russian forces launched over 100 ballistic missiles at Kyiv and the surrounding region over a two-week period.
The Houthi movement claimed attacks on Saudi airports and the Defense Ministry in Riyadh while air defenses intercepted missiles and drones.
An oil tanker was disabled in the Strait of Hormuz amid escalating Gulf shipping risks.
Militants killed 20 soldiers in an ambush in Somalia.
Large parts of Sudan's capital lost power following a drone attack.
Attacks in Ethiopia's Oromia region killed at least 60 Orthodox Christians, according to the church.
A UN inquiry report states that Israel continued committing genocide in Gaza following a truce.
Nigerian President Tinubu called for stronger African defense cooperation following an attack in Taraba state where the death toll rose to 58.
Russia provided Iran with satellite intelligence ahead of attacks on Saudi infrastructure.
The Houthis claimed a missile strike on the Ras Tanura oil refinery in Saudi Arabia.
Israeli airstrikes and attacks continued across the Gaza Strip resulting in casualties.
Houthis stated that Saudi-led airstrikes killed 13 people at a market in northern Yemen.
Bandits attacked the Binnari community in Taraba State, killing 62 people and injuring 52 others.
The UN and the Red Cross reported that drone strikes in Sudan have killed hundreds of civilians.
Ukrainian drone strikes hit a Russian steel plant and a chemical factory.
A Ukrainian drone attack on Russia's Omsk Region damaged industrial and chemical facilities and injured three people.
Ukrainian drones reportedly struck a Russian industrial plant deep inside Russian territory.
Russian forces launched ballistic missiles and 88 drones against Ukraine, with air defenses intercepting 71 targets.
The EU released €4.9 billion under the European Peace Facility to support Ukraine with military aid reimbursements and training.
Reports indicate that the Black Sea has surpassed the Strait of Hormuz as the world's deadliest route for merchant shipping.
An airstrike on a market in Darfur killed numerous people.
Witnesses report an airstrike on a Darfur market killed civilians who were selling food to fighters.
Houthi media reports Saudi strike on Yemeni petrol station kills 12 civilians
A high-speed train collision in central Spain resulted in 39 deaths and a massive emergency response.
President Volodymyr Zelenskyy reported that Russia launched more than 100 missiles against Kyiv over a two-week period.
The Russian MoD claimed air defense forces intercepted Ukrainian drones overnight across multiple regions and the Moscow area.
A UN commission reports that over 1,000 Palestinians have been killed in the West Bank since October 2023.
The EU disbursed €2.86 billion to Ukraine for drones and air defense systems.
A drone attack on a passenger bus in Zaporizhzhia resulted in one death.
Russian air defense forces intercepted and destroyed 222 Ukrainian drones over multiple regions and the Black Sea overnight.
At least 60 Orthodox Christians were killed in attacks in Ethiopia.
Saudi-led airstrikes in Yemen killed 14 people at a market.
Drone strike in Darfur, Sudan kills 102 civilians
